stem: While resolving a claim, a pharmacist learns of a quality-related event at 3 p.m. Monday. When must the initial event documentation be completed?

choices.text: Document by the end of the next business day.
Wait until the monthly CQI meeting.
Within 24 hours after the pharmacist discovered or was told of the event.
Start the clock only after the patient confirms harm.
Use the seven-business-day serious-event reporting deadline.

explanation.core_reasoning: 'Within 24 hours after the pharmacist discovered or was told of the event.' is the governing result. By contrast, 'Document by the end of the next business day.' would require that the regulation used a business-day deadline rather than 24 elapsed hours. The decisive cue appears in 'While resolving a claim, a pharmacist learns of a quality-related event at 3 p.m. Monday. When must the initial event documentation be completed?'.

choice_analysis.A: 'Document by the end of the next business day.' would apply only if the regulation used a business-day deadline rather than 24 elapsed hours; 'While resolving a claim, a pharmacist learns of a quality-related event at 3 p.m. Monday. When must the initial event documentation be completed?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.B: 'Wait until the monthly CQI meeting.' would apply only if initial event documentation could be deferred to aggregate review; 'While resolving a claim, a pharmacist learns of a quality-related event at 3 p.m. Monday. When must the initial event documentation be completed?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.C: 'Within 24 hours after the pharmacist discovered or was told of the event.': supported by qre documentation.
choice_analysis.D: 'Start the clock only after the patient confirms harm.' would apply only if the trigger were patient harm rather than discovery or notification; 'While resolving a claim, a pharmacist learns of a quality-related event at 3 p.m. Monday. When must the initial event documentation be completed?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.E: 'Use the seven-business-day serious-event reporting deadline.' would apply only if initial QRE documentation and Board reporting shared one deadline; 'While resolving a claim, a pharmacist learns of a quality-related event at 3 p.m. Monday. When must the initial event documentation be completed?' states otherwise.

related_facts: The pharmacist who discovers or receives notice of a quality-related event must initially document it within 24 hours after discovery or notification.
explanation.mpje_trap: 'Document by the end of the next business day.' would apply if the regulation used a business-day deadline rather than 24 elapsed hours. In 'While resolving a claim, a pharmacist learns of a quality-related event at 3 p.m. Monday. When must the initial event documentation be completed?', that predicate is missing.

reasoning_steps: Match the scenario's operative facts to Quality-related event documentation deadline
